fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/api and internal/workflow (go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run ShipMergeRefused and go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow -run ShipChange) with a fake Exec assert: a gh pr merge failing with 'the base branch policy prohibits the merge' makes rhiza ship merge report a refused merge naming that reason, and the ship-change workflow stops the run there without visiting gate-rebase-merge; a merge failing because the head branch is behind main or conflicting still goes to gate-rebase-merge as before.
fields.statement: When GitHub refuses a ship-change run's merge for a reason other than the PR being behind main or conflicting (a branch-protection rule, a required check, a merge method the repo does not allow), the merge step stops the run once with GitHub's reason instead of failing back through gate-rebase-merge and rebase-merge until max_visits.
